summary: Sealed car park off the loop road, backing onto bush and parkland, no homes near.

drivers.traffic: Bridge traffic 80 m away; the loop road itself looks quiet.
drivers.convention: Cars parked in both images, so a van would not stand out; no overnight use or signs seen.
